title: Non-Empty Column Delete Rule
description: Implement and enforce the defined behavior when deleting a column that still holds cards — per spec, MVP may block deleting a non-empty column; whichever rule is chosen must be predictable and must not orphan cards.
spec:
1. Choose and document the rule (block delete of a non-empty column OR move/remove its cards predictably)
2. Verify deleting an empty column succeeds
3. Verify deleting a non-empty column follows the chosen rule exactly
4. Verify no card entity is left orphaned (referenced by no column) after the operation
5. Verify the rule outcome persists across reload
